correctness.rationale: Complete face and strict-chain enumeration gives quotient cells 14,58,94,60,12; order-preserving barycentric action gives regular CW structure with valid integer incidence maps, each boundary-square composition checked exactly. 118 unimodular ±1 cancellations leave exactly Z in degrees 0 and 2. Independently, a spanning-tree presentation of original pi1 has 61 generators and 145 triangular relators and all 61 are eliminated by exact Tietze operations. The explicit three-cycle fixes a matching two-simplex; simplicity of A5 and Armstrong give quotient pi1 trivial. Hurewicz and homological Whitehead establish the complete S2 homotopy type. The embedded standalone program regenerates and asserts all counts and reductions, not just finite-field ranks.

value.rationale: Determines the complete integral homotopy type of the canonical index-two symmetry quotient of a well-studied exceptional ten-vertex graph, distinguishing it from the known contractible full S5 quotient. The previously established rational A5 sphere class did not settle integral torsion, fundamental group, or actual homotopy. The new exact S2 classification answers all of these and serves as a concrete symmetry-topology boundary case with an independently executable finite certificate.
